title: Loyalty Points from the Wider Northgate Relationship in Northgate Card Late Fee Courtesy
content:
In the courtesy reversal of a late fee on a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account, the loyalty points follow the cardholder's wider relationship with Northgate:

- where the cardholder holds a Northgate+ membership in active status, they are the whole years from that membership's enrolled date to today, at most 10;
- where the cardholder holds no Northgate+ membership in active status and outside-purchase rewards were credited on the account in the last 12 months, they are the whole tens of dollars of those rewards, at most 10;
- in every other case there are none.

**Records read.** The membership is read from the cardholder's **Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships** record: its tier (Northgate+ Assist, Northgate+ Student, Northgate+ Monthly, Northgate+ Annual or Northgate+ Business are Northgate+ memberships; the free Northgate Rewards tier is not), its status and its enrolled date. The outside-purchase rewards are the reward credits posted on the card account at statement close in the last 12 months, the window taking the entries dated after the same calendar day 12 months before today.

| Relationship | Loyalty points |
|---|---|
| Northgate+ membership in active status | whole years since its enrolled date, at most 10 |
| no active Northgate+ membership; outside rewards credited in the last 12 months | whole tens of dollars of those rewards (each 10 dollars is one point), at most 10 |
| neither | none |

Hypothetical cases: a Northgate+ Monthly membership enrolled 3 years and 11 months ago gives 3 points; one enrolled 14 years ago gives 10. No active Northgate+ membership and 47.60 of outside rewards in the last 12 months gives 4 points; 9.90 gives none; 130.00 gives 10.
